{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Fine. Just tell him that he can group kills by dozens or gross lots. It makes no difference to me.''"<br />"''Gross lots, sir?''"<br />"''A dozen dozen, Emtrey.|Wedge Antilles and Emtrey|<ref name="rogue">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
A '''gross''' referred to a dozen dozen, or one hundred and forty-four in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. It was typically used to measure lots for cargo shipment throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], it was also sometimes used to measure a particularly skilled [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] kills. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] once quipped that he didn't care if his victories were measured in dozens or gross lots, after the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] technician [[Zraii]] repainted and refurbished his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="rogue" />
